lines: This alligator is secret number one of five that streamers found in GTA 6.
Speed walked right up to it. Bad idea.
It lunged, grabbed Jason, and dragged him straight through the grass.
This parrot keeps saying, hey handsome.
Ask it where the cash is, and it screams, generator!
Behind the grate? Fourteen hundred and five dollars.
Lirik came up in the middle of the ocean, and a German shepherd was just sitting on a jet ski.
He climbed on, and the dog drove him back to shore.
Jason has a pet snake named Dolores.
And yes, you can feed her a rat. She eats it.
Lirik spotted Bigfoot in the swamp.
He went looking for him, blacked out, and woke up alone, asking, did he do something to me?
Which one would catch you off guard first?
Because it all started with this alligator.
